price_basis: Indicative installed costs, GBP, 2023-2026 prices. Secondary sources citing the Energy Saving Trust, RICS and MCS; real quotes vary widely. Shown as ranges, never as quotes.

stages.3: Low-carbon heating: sized for the improved home
stages.4: Generation: sized for the new electricity demand

loft_insulation.name: Loft insulation top-up to 270 mm
loft_insulation.cost_source: EST via Rightmove (semi-detached avg ~GBP 930, July 2023 prices); HOA (~GBP 825)

cavity_wall_insulation.name: Cavity wall insulation
cavity_wall_insulation.cost_source: NerdWallet citing typical semi-detached ~GBP 2,700; Which? (RICS cost data, Nov 2024)

solid_wall_insulation.name: Solid wall insulation (internal or external)
solid_wall_insulation.cost_source: Industry ranges for internal (lower) and external (higher) wall insulation; highly variable

glazing_upgrade.name: Upgrade to modern double glazing
glazing_upgrade.cost_source: Typical UK market ranges (GBP 400-800 per window)

smart_controls.name: Smart thermostat and heating controls
smart_controls.evidence_note: Published trials report anywhere from about 0% to 10%; 5% is a central assumption and is marked uncertain.

air_source_heat_pump.name: Air source heat pump
air_source_heat_pump.cost_source: EST (~GBP 14,000 installed), EDF (~GBP 13,000 average), before grant
air_source_heat_pump.grant_note: Boiler Upgrade Scheme: up to GBP 7,500 in England and Wales (Home Energy Scotland offers similar). Eligibility is not assessed here.
air_source_heat_pump.evidence_note: BUS requires a minimum SCOP of 2.8; monitored UK installations often achieve more. Leaky homes need higher flow temperatures and achieve lower SCOP.

solar_pv.name: Solar PV panels
solar_pv.cost_source: MCS installation data (~GBP 2,193 per kW, 2023); 2026 market quotes ~GBP 5,000-7,000 for 4 kWp
solar_pv.evidence_note: Typical UK yield is roughly 800-1,000 kWh per kWp per year depending on location, orientation and shading.
